description: Return craft guidance and live device context for a design topic. Covers legibility rules, palette discipline, layout zones, animation budget, HTML page authoring, and pre-filled next-tool suggestions based on current device state. The orientation tool to run before authoring a scene, dashboard, animation, or HTML page — or when troubleshooting display issues.

topic.description: Design topic: text (styled text guidance), scene (composition + layout zones), dashboard (widgets + metrics), animation (motion budget + effects), pixel-art (bitmap + sprite guidance), html (pixoo_render_html pages: loops, clock, sampling), troubleshooting (device + display issues).

name: pixoo_design_brief

availableThemes.description: Available named scene themes (e.g. "midnight", "ember"). Use in background.theme or pixoo_display_text theme param.

craftGuidance.description: Markdown-formatted craft rules: legibility floors, palette discipline, layout zones, and technique guidance specific to the topic.

deviceContext.description: Live device state snapshot at the time of the request.

brightness.description: Current device brightness (0–100). Absent when unreachable.

channel.description: Current device channel. Absent when unreachable.

displaySize.description: Configured display canvas size in pixels (16, 32, or 64). Design coordinates scale to this value.

reachable.description: True if device is currently reachable. When false, push: false is implied for all render tools.

screenOn.description: True if screen is on. Absent when unreachable.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

htmlRenderer.description: Whether pixoo_render_html can render: available; disabled (PIXOO_HTML_ENABLED=false, so the tool is not listed); or no_browser (no browser found, so the tool fails browser_unavailable until one is installed).

iconCategories.description: Built-in icon names grouped by category (weather, arrows, status, media). Use names in pixoo_compose_scene icon elements.

nextToolSuggestions.description: Suggested next steps based on topic and device state.

items.description: A recommended follow-up call with its arguments pre-filled.

args.description: Pre-filled arguments for the call; {} when the tool needs none.

reason.description: Why this step is recommended given the current device state.

title: pixoo_design_brief
